name: str_length
done: Counts code points with stri_length and copies names.
case: Repeated Unicode strings, a scalar, NA, empty, NULL, a named vector, numbers, and logicals.

name: str_width
done: Counts display columns with stri_width and copies names.
case: Hanzi, emoji, umlauts, a zero-width space, soft hyphen, NA, empty, NULL, and logicals.

name: str_dup
done: Recycles with vec_recycle_common, then duplicates with stri_dup or paste when sep is set.
case: Repeated fruit, separators, NA, zero and negative counts, NULL, fractional counts, and recycled names.

name: str_c
done: Drops NULL pieces, checks sizes, and joins with stri_c.
case: Repeated letters with a separator, NULL pieces, an empty call, NA rows, collapse, and numbers.

name: str_flatten
done: Joins one vector with stri_flatten, using last in place of the final separator.
case: Repeated letters, a final separator, NA with and without na.rm, empty, NULL, and numbers.

name: str_flatten_comma
done: Flattens on commas and removes an Oxford comma when there are two pieces.
case: Repeated four-letter groups, two and three names, a bare comma, an or-ending, and a missing pair.

name: str_sub
done: Extracts code-point ranges with stri_sub after the common-size check.
case: A repeated block, negative indexes, a start/end matrix, a start/length matrix, NA, and names.

name: str_sub_all
done: Extracts several ranges from each string with stri_sub_all.
case: Shared ranges, a locate matrix, a length matrix, per-string starts, names, and an empty input.

name: str_sub<-
case: A repeated replacement, the BBCDEF chain, omit_na, a matrix of ranges, and a missing index.

name: str_escape
case: Repeated metacharacters, a dot, NA, an empty string, names, and NULL.

name: str_conv
done: Reinterprets bytes in the given encoding and returns UTF-8 with stri_conv.
case: Byte 177 as ISO-8859-2 and ISO-8859-1, UTF-8 text, NULL, empty, NA, and a named raw string.
